paite: Ka unaute aw, na lak uah mi tampi heutu in hong om kei un, heutu in vaihawmna thupi sem atuak ding chih i thei uhi.
heading: Lei Thuzohna
english: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

paite: Thil tampi ah i vek un i gilou nak uhi. Kuapeuh thugen lam a agitlouh keileh mi piching ahi a, apumpi vengtheimi ahi.
english: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

paite: Ngai un, sakolte'n i thu aman theihna ding ua akam ua kamkaihna sikkual i batleh apumpi uh i kaihei hi.
english: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

paite: Longpite leng ngaihtuah sam un, alian mahmah ua, huih hat mutleng in a-om nak uhi, himahleh alonghekpa'n apaisak utna lam peuh ah ahekna neuchik petmah in akiheisak hi.
english: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

paite: Hichibang in leitung pumpi hiang neuchik ahi a, nakpitak in aki-uangsak nak hi. Ngai un, meikuang neuchik phet in gammang nak katsak na tel e!
english: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

paite: Huan lei tuh meikuang ahi, pumpi hiangte lak a gitlouhna lumpi, pumpi avek a ninsak a, mihing kisuansawndan pianphungpi kangsak ahi; huai lei mah in gawtmun mei toh apeh hi.
english: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

paite: Sa chi chih, vasa chi chih, ganhing chi chih tuipi ate khoizual theih ahi ua, mite khoizual in a-om uhi.
english: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

paite: Himahleh lei zaw kuamah in akhoizual thei kei uhi; sihna gu a dim gilou om kinken thei lou ahi.
english: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

paite: Huai lei in Pa Pathian i phat ua; huai mah in Pathian bang a bawl mihingte i hamsiat uhi.
english: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

paite: Kam khat a kipan in phatna leh hamsia apawt nak hi. Ka unaute aw, huchibang ding hilou ahi.
english: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

paite: Tuikhuk khat in nak khat mah a kipan in tui lim leh lim lou asuaksak zel a hia?
english: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

paite: Ka unaute aw, theipi kung ah olive thei agah thei a hia? Ahihkeileh grepgui ah theipi agah thei a hia? Huchibang in chikhuk in tui al lou asuaksak thei sam kei hi.
english: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

paite: Na lak uah kua apil in, thu atheithei a? Thunuailut leh piltak in athilhihte omdan hoih in ensak hen.
heading: Tunglam A Pan Pilna
english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

paite: Himahleh na lungtang uah hazatna thupitak leh kidemna na neih uleh thudik zuausan kei un.
english: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

paite: Huai bang pilna zaw tunglam a kipan a hong paisuk ahi kei a, lei lam thil, khamitlouhna leh dawi lam thil a kipan ahi zaw hi.
english: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

paite: Hazatna leh kidemna omna ah buaina leh thilhihkhelhna chiteng a-om hi.
english: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

paite: Tunglam a kipan pilna bel, atung in asiangthou phot a, huai khit in kituah a-ut a, anunnem a, achihnuam a, zahngaihna leh gah hoih in adim a, khentuam anei kei a, alepchiah kei hi.
english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

paite: Huan diktatna gah zaw lemna bawlmi in lemna a atuh ahi.
english: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
